scripts.build: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=1 go build -mod=readonly -trimpath -o ./bin/gateway ./cmd/gateway && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=1 go build -mod=readonly -trimpath -o ./bin/telegram ./cmd/telegram
scripts.test: GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=1 go test -parallel=2 -race ./... && bash scripts/test-production-smoke.sh
scripts.api:generate: GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-p=1 go tool oapi-codegen -config internal/groceryapi/oapi-codegen.yaml api/openapi/grocery-gateway.yaml
scripts.api:check: pnpm run api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- internal/groceryapi/generated.go
